# Servlet, Pages, EL and Annotations APIs that Jakarta EE 10 and 11 removed, in their javax names
# (the overlay WARs are still javax).  Format:  class <internal name> <spec> | member <owner>
# <name><descriptor> <spec>.  A member rule for a field uses <name>:<descriptor>.
#
# Generated by diffing the public and protected API of Tomcat 9.0.122's servlet-api, jsp-api,
# el-api and annotations-api jars against Tomcat 11.0.26's (jakarta renamed to javax), then
# labelled by the specification that removed each entry:  Servlet 6.0 and EL 5.0 (Jakarta EE 10,
# already gone on Tomcat 10.1), Pages 4.0, EL 6.0 and Annotations 3.0 (Jakarta EE 11, Tomcat 11).
# Servlet 6.1 removed nothing beyond Servlet 6.0's list.  Constant fields (BodyTag.EVAL_BODY_TAG,
# ELResolver.TYPE and RESOLVABLE_AT_DESIGN_TIME) are inlined by javac, so a reference to them
# usually leaves no trace in bytecode;  they are listed for completeness.
